label: bucket storage-backend migration
type: changing an existing Couchbase bucket's storage engine between Couchstore and Magma (Enterprise Edition), which rewrites every document on disk. Only two operations trigger the rewrite - a swap rebalance, or a graceful failover followed by full recovery - and while migration is in progress only the bucket's ramQuota may be edited. Cannot cross vBucket counts.
evidence: The two ways to trigger this rewrite are to perform a swap rebalance or a graceful failover followed by a full recovery.
The backend migration described in this section does not support migrating between buckets with different number of vBuckets.
When migrating a bucket between storage backends, you can edit only the bucket's [ramQuota]
After you change the ejection policy while migrating the storage backend, the policy does not take effect until migration completes.
note: The single most constraint-dense operation in the round after the address-family changeover, and the one that most clearly needs the vocabulary of three other subtrees at once: it is a BUCKET operation whose only triggers are NODE operations (swap rebalance, graceful failover plus full recovery) and whose constraints are STORAGE-engine facts. Round 26 promoted server:graceful-failover and server:full-recovery in the same pass, so this record can now state its triggers in terms the registry actually holds - which it could not have done before this round.
relates_to_competency_question: How does an administrator move a bucket from Couchstore to Magma, and what may be changed while that runs?
